court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sayed Azazur Rahman And Anr vs Nkgsb (North Kanara Gaud Saraswat Bank)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sayed Azazur Rahman And Anr — applicants/petitioners
parties.respondent_defendant: NKGSB (North Kanara Gaud Saraswat Bank) — respondent

facts_of_case: The applicant sought an interim relief in a challenge to an arbitral award. The bank had invoked arbitration under the Multi State Cooperative Societies Act 2002 and claimed that the applicants defaulted on a loan.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking a stay of enforcement of an arbitral award must demonstrate compelling reasons.
legal_principles.held: Having regard to these circumstances, it is difficult to see how there can be unconditional stay.
cited_cases: Sayed Azazur Rahman And Anr vs Nkgsb (North Kanara Gaud Saraswat Bank), 2019

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking a stay of enforcement of an arbitral award must demonstrate compelling reasons.
legal_principles.held: Prayer clauses (a), (b) and (c) cannot be unconditionally granted.
cited_cases: Sayed Azazur Rahman And Anr vs Nkgsb (North Kanara Gaud Saraswat Bank), 2019
